# awdns Provider

Manage Authentic Web DNS hosted zones and records via the AW external API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    awdns = {
      source = "AuthenticWeb/awdns"
    }
  }
}

# Authenticate with an OAuth2 client-credentials pair issued by Authentic Web.
provider "awdns" {
  client_id     = var.awdns_client_id
  client_secret = var.awdns_client_secret

  # Optional overrides:
  # base_url        = "https://api.authenticweb.com/external/v1"
  # request_timeout = 30
}

variable "awdns_client_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "OAuth2 client ID for the AW external API."
}

variable "awdns_client_secret" {
  type        = string
  description = "OAuth2 client secret for the AW external API."
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the AW external API. May also be set with the `AWDNS_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.authenticweb.com/external/v1`.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID for the AW external API (client-credentials grant). May also be set with the `AWDNS_CLIENT_ID` environment variable; the argument takes precedence.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret for the AW external API (client-credentials grant). May also be set with the `AWDNS_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable; the argument takes precedence.
- `request_timeout` (Number) Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30. Reserved for a future SDK option; not yet enforced by the client.
